note: Read on every deal by seller_r3.py, so it can be switched off or changed without a restart once a restarted seller runs this code. Base: catalogue list price. Boundary: the quote is at most floor(list x ratio); a unit whose list price is max_list_price or more is left alone. The floor is never lowered: when it is above the ceiling the quote is the floor, recorded in logs/pricing and signed-offers as price_cap.state floor_bound. Evidence: raters YAHO1212, psyoung82 and mjforge give 5 up to about .798 and 4 from about .802, on 8,469 reviews of 2026-11-06; a gain to our star rank is not shown yet.

pq1.note: Opening-quote A/B, approved by the user on 11-10: by task hash (salt pq1) the share in the test arm open at max(floor, floor(list x .70)) on every goods unit, 1M+ included; the control arm keeps the cap above. Needs a seller restarted on code with pq1_v1; read on every deal.
